title: Gallery | Machin Nursery Farms - Tropical Plants and Nursery
description: Explore photos of tropical plants and nursery facilities at Machin Nursery Farms in Homestead, Florida. Contact us for plant availability.
main:
Machin Nursery Farms Gallery

View photos of our tropical plant inventory, nursery facilities in South Florida.

Tropical Plant Inventory

Our retail nursery features a curated selection of tropical plants, privacy hedges, and ornamental trees adapted to South Florida climate. Visit to explore live plant specimens, discuss species options with our team, and select plants for your landscaping project.

Support for Your Landscape Project

Explore photographs of the nursery and its plants. Contact our team to discuss plant selection, delivery, or installation for your project.

Visit Our Nursery

To see our complete plant inventory in person, visit our main retail location during business hours. Our team can provide hands-on recommendations, explain specific plant characteristics, and help you select the right specimens for your yard or landscape project.

Main Location: 30760 SW 212 Ave, Homestead, FL 33030
Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; Sunday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM
